source_definition.name: industrial green carpet
source_definition.description: Firm, low-pile, high-durability carpet in a green color, for laying down on bare concrete, with a still-functioning light attached to the ceiling above.

source_definition.name: reinforced concrete wall
source_definition.description: An extremely resilient wall, filled with concrete and rebar.  Best suited for supporting multi-level buildings, only serious explosives and high-speed impacts would be capable of damaging this wall.

source_definition.name: folded wall
source_definition.description: When looked at out of the side of the eye, this wall seems to bend and curve in on itself and when looked at head on it seems to be a repeating pattern of solid concrete hexagons.

source_definition.name: unfolded wall
source_definition.description: This wall tessellates as you view it.

source_definition.name: open air
source_definition.description: An area of open air in what appears to be a shaft extending into the depths of the earth.  You cannot understand how or why someone would build an elevator shaft going into the depths of the earth like this for reasons other than mining.  It's bottom, if there is one, seems to be far past where light penetrates.

names: Climb down by lowering yourself from the ledge.
Can't jump across (need a small gap).
effect.title: There is a ledge here.  What do you want to do?
descriptions: You look down as far as you can see.
You hang off the ledge to get closer to a bottom you cannot see.

false_effect.u_message: You look down and see the elevator shaft going deeper than you expected.  Much deeper to where you can no longer see beyond.

effect.u_message: You receive an uncontrollable compulsion to step forward into the open elevator shaft.  As you step into the open air… you fall.  Then you keep falling.  The shaft you thought was only a few stories in height must be miles.  You lose count repeatedly but slowly, finally, the floor approaches… THUMP!  You feel searing final pain as every part of your body breaks when you hit the ground.

…After feeling indescribable pain mere moments ago, unexplainably, you awaken somewhere near the facility.  Somehow your body has been restored, as if you haven't plummeted down the elevator in the first place.

You climb down as far as you can and then you let go… you fall.  Then you keep falling.  The shaft you thought was only a few stories in height must be miles.  You try to count but every so often you scrape up against the wall abrading the skin from your limbs, and bruising you to the bone.  You pass out long before you ever hit the bottom.

…Against all odds, you come back to your senses somewhere near the facility; your head still pounding from the inscrutable agony you went though.  Somehow your body has been reverted back to the state right before your fall.
Jump where?  There's nothing to jump to.  Just the other side of the elevator shaft.  There's no ledge over there or stairs, just flat wall.

As you step into the open air… you fall.  Then you keep falling.  The shaft you thought was only a few stories in height must be miles.  You lose count repeatedly but slowly, finally, the floor approaches…  THUMP!  You feel searing final pain as every part of your body breaks when you hit the ground.

…After feeling indescribable pain mere moments ago, unexplainably, you awaken somewhere near the facility.  Somehow your body has been restored, as if you haven't plummeted down the elevator in the first place.

As you ascend, you inexplicably lose purchase and orientation, and then… you fall.  Then you keep falling.  The shaft you thought was only a few stories in height must be miles.  You lose count repeatedly but slowly, finally, the floor approaches…  THUMP!  You feel searing final pain as every part of your body breaks when you hit the ground.

…After feeling indescribable pain mere moments ago, unexplainably, you awaken somewhere near the facility.  Somehow your body has been restored, as if you haven't plummeted down the elevator in the first place.

source_definition.name: laser chamber
source_definition.description: A large section of metal tubing, balanced on spring supports to prevent any vibration from affecting the laser inside.

source_definition.name: spatial compressor
source_definition.description: A dizzyingly complex series of devices and readouts is on the outside of this machine's casing.  You imagine the inside would be incomprehensible.

source_definition.name: fractal compressor
source_definition.description: This space is infinite, and has no beginning or end.  But you can see both right here, in this churning mass of angles.

source_definition.name: unfolded laser chamber
source_definition.description: You can see the inside surface of this tube, and what it contains.  Thick, slimy red light oozes within it.

bash.sound: a hollow pop, followed by a sickly wet squelching as congealed light slowly leaks out of the tube.

source_definition.name: leaking laser chamber
source_definition.description: Gobbets of congealed light drip from the gash in the side of this chamber like hot marmalade.

source_definition.name: concrete floor
source_definition.description: You can see every side of every crack in this worn concrete, all the way down.  You can't look at it for too long.

source_definition.name: reinforced concrete wall
source_definition.description: You can see every side of every crack in this worn concrete, all the way down.  You can't look at it for too long.

source_definition.name: card reader
source_definition.description: A smartcard reader.  It bears the letters LIXA in proud silver.

examine_action.success_msg:
You insert your ID card.
<color_light_green>The nearby doors unlock.</color>
examine_action.redundant_msg: The nearby doors are already opened.

source_definition.name: rewired card reader
source_definition.description: A smartcard reader.  The casing is damaged, and repaired with tape.

examine_action.success_msg:
You insert your ID card.
<color_light_green>The nearby doors unlock.</color>
examine_action.redundant_msg: The nearby doors are already opened.

source_definition.name: PPE locker card reader
source_definition.description: A smartcard reader.  The label above it reads 'SECURE PPE LOCKER'.

examine_action.success_msg:
You insert your ID card.
<color_light_green>The nearby doors unlock.</color>
examine_action.redundant_msg: The nearby doors are already opened.

source_definition.name: card reader
source_definition.description: A smartcard reader.  It is a forbidding black, with no symbols of any sort to identify it.

examine_action.success_msg:
You insert your ID card.
<color_light_green>The nearby doors unlock.</color>
examine_action.redundant_msg: The nearby doors are already opened.

source_definition.name: precision laser emitter
source_definition.description: A huge casing for a device that generates and focuses a laser of an incredibly precise wavelength.

source_definition.name: wall of flat space
source_definition.description: From a distance, this looks like where the chamber ends; a flat wall, with a very detailed painting of a tunnel behind it.  But as you get closer, you can see how it ripples, like lazy water, and notice angles of the space beyond that a flat image could never give.

source_definition.name: unfolded machinery
source_definition.description: This inscrutable device is filled with wires, boards, and connections.  You can see every one of them, and it gives you a headache.

source_definition.name: photonic conduit
source_definition.description: You can see through the metal casing of this tube, into the blazing light coursing through it.

source_definition.name: whiteboard
source_definition.description: A wide space of whiteboard, for writing on with washable markers.  No one has washed it in a long time, though; it is covered in dense scrawls of equations and waveform diagrams.

source_definition.name: electronic locked metal door
source_definition.description: An extremely resilient door made of assorted steel, carved and pounded into shape.  It is locked by an electronic keypad.

false_effect.u_message: You press four random buttons and nothing happens.

terrain.message: You enter the code and door mechanism clicks as it unlocks.
